blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Four times the quantity x plus three equals four x plus twelve. Which property does it show?
The four outside is multiplied by each term inside: four times x, and four times three.
Four times three is twelve. Multiplying across a sum is the distributive property.
So the answer is the distributive property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the commutative property, because no two terms just trade places. It isn't the associative property, because the parentheses don't just move.
